paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是人们精心计划一个完美的夜晚，最后却发现事情根本不会按照预想发展。

这天是克莱尔和菲尔的结婚纪念日。菲尔送给克莱尔好几件用心准备的礼物，其中还有一条藏在立体幻灯机里的手链。克莱尔却只送了他几张自己做的“免费拥抱券”，因此很尴尬，因为菲尔显然比她更会挑礼物。

她赶紧声称，菲尔真正的礼物要到当天晚上才会出现，尽管她其实什么都还没准备。随后她想起，两个人第一次接吻时，现场正播放着斯潘道芭蕾乐队的《True》。于是她找到乐队的一位前成员，请他到家里的客厅现场演唱这首歌。

克莱尔确信菲尔一定会喜欢，可菲尔甚至没认出那位音乐人。他最后承认，自己从来都不喜欢那个乐队，而且《True》其实也不是他们的歌。克莱尔很受打击，因为她真的想送给菲尔一件有意义的礼物。菲尔告诉她，弄错并不重要。她付出的心思已经说明了她有多爱他，而现在，他们反而拥有了一首新的专属歌曲。

与此同时，米切尔和卡梅隆决定过一个完全不聊孩子的夜晚，于是让格洛丽亚照顾莉莉，自己去见老朋友萨尔。萨尔还是像他们记忆中那样，吵闹、疯狂，而且随时准备出去玩。

一开始，三个人玩得很开心。但每当米切尔和卡梅隆提到莉莉时，萨尔就会不高兴，还会拿她开一些非常黑暗的玩笑。两个人很快意识到，萨尔其实是在嫉妒。莉莉出现以前，他们会把更多注意力放在萨尔身上。现在他们很少联系她，让她觉得自己被取代了。

米切尔和卡梅隆向她保证，他们依然爱她，而且她随时都可以打电话。几分钟后，萨尔因为喝得太多睡着了，两个人最后像照顾另一个孩子一样照顾她。

在杰和格洛丽亚家，所有孙辈都来参加“杰之夜”。杰做了自己的招牌肉酱三明治，让所有人换上睡衣，还计划一起看一部老西部片。

海莉想早点离开，去参加附近的一场聚会。杰一眼看穿了她的计划，拒绝让她走。格洛丽亚告诉他，海莉不是在拒绝他，她只是个想去见朋友的青少年。杰承认，他只是想让孙辈们多留在自己身边一会儿，因为他们长大得实在太快了。

他最后还是让海莉走了，迪伦也来接她。可迪伦闻到食物的香味，又看到大家在看西部片后，决定留下来。最后反而是海莉坐在那里等着，而男孩们开心地享受“杰之夜”。

所有人的计划都没有按照预想进行，但每个人依然得到了自己真正需要的东西。克莱尔和菲尔更加理解了彼此，萨尔知道自己没有被遗忘，而杰也多争取到了一点和家人在一起的时间。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about people planning a perfect night and then finding out that things don’t go the way they expected.

It’s Claire and Phil’s anniversary, and Phil gives Claire several thoughtful gifts, including a bracelet hidden inside a View-Master. Claire only gives him homemade coupons for free hugs, and she feels embarrassed because Phil is much better at giving gifts.

She quickly claims that his real present is coming that night, even though she hasn’t planned anything. Then she remembers that “True” by Spandau Ballet was playing when they first kissed. She finds a former member of the band and hires him to perform the song in their living room.

Claire is sure Phil will love it, but he doesn’t even recognize the musician. He finally admits that he never liked the band and that “True” isn’t actually their song. Claire is crushed because she wanted to give him something meaningful. Phil tells her the mistake doesn’t matter. The effort shows how much she loves him, and now they have a new song together.

Meanwhile, Mitchell and Cameron decide they need a night without baby talk, so Gloria babysits Lily while they meet their old friend Sal. Sal is loud, wild, and always ready to party, just as they remember her.

At first, the three of them have a great time. But whenever Mitchell and Cameron mention Lily, Sal gets annoyed and makes some very dark jokes about her. They soon realize that Sal is jealous. Before Lily arrived, they gave Sal much more attention. Now they rarely call, and she feels like she’s been replaced.

Mitchell and Cameron assure her that they still love her and that she can always call them. A few minutes later, Sal falls asleep after drinking too much, and they end up taking care of her almost like another child.

At Jay and Gloria’s house, all the grandchildren come over for “Jay’s Night.” Jay makes his special sloppy joes, gets everyone into pajamas, and plans to watch an old Western.

Haley wants to leave early for a party nearby. Jay sees through her plan and refuses to let her go. Gloria tells him that Haley isn’t rejecting him. She’s simply a teenager who wants to see her friends. Jay admits that he just wants to keep the grandchildren around a little longer because they’re growing up so quickly.

He finally lets Haley go, and Dylan arrives to pick her up. But once Dylan smells the food and sees the Western, he decides to stay. Haley ends up waiting while the boys enjoy Jay’s Night.

None of the plans works out as expected, but everyone still gets something they need. Claire and Phil understand each other better, Sal knows she hasn’t been forgotten, and Jay gets a little more time with his family.
